located_point.method: Site index point retained (Wikidata 'Kotda', a village). The composite shows fields, a river and the village; a squarish field-like patch of about 150 m lies about 500 m north-west of the point, but without a plan it cannot be identified with the fortification, so the mound was not located independently.

sources.imagery_result: no lines: no plan or description was available to tie any straight feature to the fortification

notes: The only plan of Kotada Bhadli in the held sources is panel D of Abhayan et al. 2025 Fig. 2, drawn over a commercial basemap; the plan library excludes it and so did we. The held Indian Archaeology volumes predate the excavation. A repeat needs the excavators' preliminary report (Excavations at Kotada Bhadli, District Kachchh, Gujarat: A Preliminary Report) with its plan.
unmeasurable_reason: No usable plan: the only held plan is drawn over commercial imagery and is excluded, and without a plan no imagery feature can be identified as Harappan architecture.
